coordinate_system: x from the left edge, y from the top edge, millimetres, front view as the climber sees it. Each Micro is a separate 110 x 40 mm block; six blocks (three depth pairs) are sold as a set and mounted wherever the user likes, typically under or beside a 1000/2000.
notes: Only the 110 x 40 mm footprint and the 10 / 8 / 6 mm edge depths are published by Beastmaker. Block thickness and screw positions are estimates from the product photos.

Because the blocks are mounted freely, an app should let the user place the three pairs relative to the main board rather than assuming fixed positions; the layout below is one block with the edge along its top.
